sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2023 Porsche 911 Carrera T Coupe, finished in GT Silver Metallic with a black interior, and will be displayed live at Willow Springs Reimagined as part of the Cars & Bids Willow Springs Collection. This 911 features the desirable 7-speed manual transmission. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, this 911 is a Carrera T model, and comes equipped with over $13,000 in options. A partial list of notable equipment includes the Sport Chrono Package, 20-inch wheels in Satin Black, Porsche Active Suspension Management (PASM), a front axle lift system, a sports exhaust system, 18-way Adaptive Sport Seats Plus, and a Surround View camera. Notable modifications reported by the seller include clear side marker lights, Kies Motorsports wheel spacers, a Nine Volt MagSafe phone charger, and a NOCO quick connect battery charger. Released for 2023, the 992 Carrera T borrows several performance features from the Carrera S, including a standard mechanical limited-slip differential, lowered PASM sport suspension, and a sports exhaust system – and it sheds 100 pounds compared to the base Carrera, thanks to several weight-saving measures, like reduced deadening and thinner window glass. Power comes from a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter flat-6, rated at 379 horsepower and 331 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed manual transmission.
